description: This file defines the PlacementService class responsible for managing placement decisions in Orleans runtime. It includes methods for addressing messages, selecting compatible silos, and managing placement workers, along with internal classes and logging.

classes.name: PlacementService
classes.description: Manages placement decisions, message addressing, and silo selection in Orleans runtime.

classes.name: PlacementWorker
classes.description: Handles asynchronous placement work, including message processing and activation placement.

classes.name: PlacementWorker.GrainPlacementWorkItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of placement work with associated messages and result task.

methods.name: AddressMessage
methods.description: Addresses a message to the appropriate silo, using cache or worker.

methods.name: SetMessageTargetPlacement
methods.description: Sets the target silo for a message.

methods.name: GetCompatibleSilos
methods.description: Returns silos compatible with a given placement target, considering filters and interface versions.

methods.name: AllActiveSilos
methods.description: Returns all active silos, or the local silo if none are known.

methods.name: GetCompatibleSilosWithVersions
methods.description: Returns silos compatible with a specific interface version.

methods.name: CachedAddressIsValid
methods.description: Checks if a cached grain address is still valid for a message.

methods.name: PlaceGrainAsync
methods.description: Places a grain asynchronously using a specified placement strategy.
